Lara Chen: Quick sync — we need to prioritize compliance work for next two sprints. Customers are asking for: 1) immutable audit logs export 2) BYOK/KMS integrations 3) SOC2 evidence packaging 4) configurable retention.

Nish Patel: Agree. Do we have rough cost/ops impact for 90d vs 365d retention?

Samir Gomez: 90d is cheap; 365d increases storage cost ~4x and impacts rehydrate latency. Also more legal hold surface.

Kevin O'Neill: Ops note: immutable exports require signing + chain-of-custody metadata. We need to lock schema v1 before GA.

Lara Chen: Proposed prioritization buckets: P0: immutable audit export (for finserv pilot), P1: BYOK handoff + KMS rotation workflow, P2: retention UI + default 90d, P3: SOC2 evidence formatting automation.

Nish Patel: Can we scope BYOK MVP to KMS handshake + support for AES-GCM wrapped keys? That narrows engineering scope.

Samir Gomez: +1 to AES-GCM. Legal wants explicit exportability SLA (48h evidence package). Add to acceptance criteria.

Kevin O'Neill: Oncall impact: must ensure export job is resumable and idempotent. Add runbook item.

Lara Chen: Acceptance criteria draft:
- Export: signed, append-only log, gzipped JSONL, includes signer cert chain and digest (sha256)
- BYOK: customer KMS key binding, rotation API, one manual key-rotate test
- Retention: configurable per-tenant, defaults to 90d, backend TTL enforcement + queued purge audit event
- SOC2: automated evidence bundle generation endpoint + checksum

Nish Patel: Can we add a perf target? Export generation <= 2h for 30M events.

Samir Gomez: We can optimize by streaming with prefix KV cache; should hit <=2h if we shard by day.

Lara Chen: Customers to consult on P0: NovaBank (needs immutability) and AcmeFin (BYOK). I'll loop them in.

ops-bot: Reminder: schedule export compliance review meeting — <https://cal.link/30min>

Kevin O'Neill: Next steps: engineering spike for export format + BYOK handshake (2w), then triage to dedicated sprint. Anyone object?

Nish Patel: No objections. I'll add to roadmap doc and send PR for acceptance crits.

Samir Gomez: I'll own the spike.

Lara Chen: Awesome — tagging @Samir and @Nish. Let's reconvene after spike with metrics. :thumbsup:
